nodes.label: Rule: logical properties only
nodes.rationale: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end, text-align:start (and inset-inline) -- never left/right physical properties. The whole deck is authored dir="rtl", so a physical property is a latent bug the moment anything is mirrored.

nodes.label: Rule: what stays LTR inside RTL
nodes.rationale: Two deliberate exceptions to the mirror: file trees are forced dir="ltr", and commands plus reference numbers stay LTR. Mirroring a path or a shell command would make it wrong, not just odd -- so these are pinned rather than flipped.

nodes.label: --brand-teal-soft
nodes.rationale: Soft teal tint used as the fill of a 'rule' callout, with a 6px border-inline-start in full teal -- the same callout shape as the amber warning, tinted for a positive/rule note instead of a caution.
